name: yucode
description: A coding-agent harness for a locked-down corporate Windows box.
//: No "bin": nothing is ever installed globally or linked on the target
machine. yucode.cmd is the only launcher, and it is plain text so that
nothing unsigned is generated at install time.
typescript is pinned below 7 deliberately: 7.x is the native compiler and
lists twenty platform packages in dependencies as well as
optionalDependencies, so omit=optional does not exclude them and
check-no-binaries fails on a plain install. See docs/REWRITE_PLAN.md §0.0
